title: Work on everything
description: First-party standing stewardship goal: keeps the whole workspace moving. Its agent triages the unowned frontier, places and arbitrates work through the claim layer, drives the Blender idea loop (grade, triage, promote/iterate/deprecate), and reports on a steady cadence — creating, placing, arbitrating, and killing work, never implementing it. Installing lands an inactive stub with no agent and no spend; starting it is a separate deliberate act.
